dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP), Richardson's syndrome

Alternatives:
1. Dorsal midbrain structural lesion (e.g., pineal region tumor or midbrain infarction) – would expect pupillary light-near dissociation, convergence-retraction nystagmus, or asymmetry
2. Corticobasal degeneration – usually asymmetric, with limb apraxia, alien limb, cortical sensory loss
3. Wernicke encephalopathy – would expect ataxia, confusion, ophthalmoplegia involving more than downgaze; nutritional history relevant
